page_title: HOL 0-3 WER | Holstein Kiel v Werder Bremen 29/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' 0 - 3 Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Romano Schmid goes off the pitch and Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) comes on.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Amos Pieper departs the field of play to be replaced by Anthony Jung (Werder Bremen).
85' Ole Werner prepares a substitution. Jens Stage is replaced by Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen).
84' The linesman signals that Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
82' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Sascha Stegemann didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
82' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) turns on the edge of the box and immediately fires in a shot at goal, but the keeper can relax as it spins well wide of the left post.
77' That's the end of the game for Finn Porath, who is replaced by Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel).

70' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
68' 12:4 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
66' Steven Skrzybski (Holstein Kiel) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
65' Holstein Kiel have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
64' Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen) creates space for himself on the edge of the box and smacks a hard shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's an easy save for Thomas Dahne.
61' Here's the change. Nicolai Remberg leaves the pitch and Benedikt Pichler (Holstein Kiel) comes on as a substitute.
59' 0 - 2 Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) finds some space on the edge of the penalty box and smashes the ball into the top right corner! What a beauty!
57' The current number of shots on goal is 0:3.
56' David Zec (Holstein Kiel) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
52' A yellow card for a tackle by Alexander Bernhardsson (Holstein Kiel). Sascha Stegemann doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
49' David Zec (Holstein Kiel) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Holstein Kiel can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel).
42' Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle. Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) commits a foul after dangerous play.
38' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen) heads on.

35' Here is a change. Lasse Rosenboom is going off and Marcel Rapp gives the last tactical orders to Timo Becker (Holstein Kiel).
35' Substitution. Marko Ivezic makes way for Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel).
33' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Werder Bremen.
28' A snap shot by Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel) from distance flies well wide of the right post.
26' Marko Ivezic (Holstein Kiel) sees a yellow card from Sascha Stegemann after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.

25' 0 - 1 Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) takes the free kick from a promising position. He has already proven that he can handle such situations and once again, he sends the ball goalwards and it bounces in off the right post.
24' Nicolai Remberg (Holstein Kiel) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Sascha Stegemann ignores the protests.
20' Total attempts – 1:4.
18' Steven Skrzybski (Holstein Kiel) picks up an injury.
16' Sascha Stegemann rightly pulls out a yellow card and shows it to Lasse Rosenboom (Holstein Kiel).
13' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) should have done it better. He won the ball from the resulting free kick, but fired well wide of the left post.
12' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) misses a great chance! He latches on to a fine cross into the box, but his effort misses the right post by a whisker.
10' Steven Skrzybski (Holstein Kiel) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
9' Lasse Rosenboom (Holstein Kiel) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
